# Moonlit observatory stone surfaces

Downloaded from the official Poly Haven asset API on 2026-10-26, at 1K resolution.

- Stone Albedo / Stone Normal: **Old Stone Wall**, Charlotte Baglioni.
  https://polyhaven.com/a/old_stone_wall
- Rock Albedo / Rock Normal: texture maps from **Rock Face 02**, Dario Barresi and Rico Cilliers.
  https://polyhaven.com/a/rock_face_02

License: **CC0 1.0 Universal**, https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Official license statement: https://polyhaven.com/license

The observatory meshes, layout and inlay are project-authored. No third-party executable
code, shaders, sample scenes or gameplay components are imported.

The previously proposed Realistic Ruins sample could not be downloaded due to repeated
connection failures and is not included in this project.
